name: Control Room evidence provenance and claim supersession
acceptanceCriteria: Equivalent JSON evidence produces one canonical SHA-256 digest regardless of object key order, including safe preservation of own __proto__ keys.
A claim is bound to source ID, source SHA-256, observation SHA-256, and a recomputable claim SHA-256 before it can be superseded.
Mutated source bytes, observation content, or claim content fail closed instead of silently reusing the old claim.
Only a verified_current claim can transition to superseded_historical.
Sanitized juss-proof/v1 receipts can supersede a prior receipt only when schema, project, repository verification authority, exact-head operation, and chronology are compatible.
The implementation never reads or exports teen, parent, journal, voice, Circle, private-message, credential, or raw-log content.

verification.note: Integrated on the repository-compliant review branch. Exact-head CI and merge-to-main evidence are required before raising verification state.

allowedEvidence: provider receipts that already satisfy the Control Room allowlist

rollback: Revert the provenance integration commits. No database, Supabase, teen-runtime, parent-runtime, or production content migration is introduced.
